description: Mass of polyester fibre per m2 of coverage
source: common sense: yarn share of PVC-coated PES fabric
comments: Common-sense estimate (Claude, for LCA-team review): Kept 0.3 kg/m2: polyester yarn is roughly 25-35% of a 0.8-1.3 kg/m2 coated membrane; see the model-gap note (PVC coating not modelled). Range 0.24-0.36 = +-20%. | earlier note: MODEL GAP: real PVC-coated polyester membranes weigh ~0.8-1.3 kg/m2 (e.g. 1250-1300 g/m2 type III fabrics on the market); only ~25-35% of that is polyester yarn, the rest is PVC coating, which has no row in this baseline. 0.3 kg/m2 approximates the polyester alone. Adding a PVC coating production row (needs an activity on unit_burdens_dataSources) would be the fix; not done without asking.

description: Amount of polyester fiber per kg of product
comments: Common-sense estimate (Claude, for LCA-team review): 1 kg of membrane textile is 1 kg polyester fibre (coating not modelled). | [2026-10-16] Fixed (was a +-20 % range): 1 kg of product is 1 kg of this material

description: Amount of weaving per kg of product
comments: Common-sense estimate (Claude, for LCA-team review): Weaving is a per-kg process on the fabric, so 1 kg of weaving per kg of membrane. | [2026-10-16] Fixed (was a +-20 % range): 1 kg of product is 1 kg of this material

description: Years the product lasts in use
source: PVC-coated polyester membranes: design life ~15-20 y, 10-15 y in high-UV climates (Birdair PVC membrane page; ETS PVC membrane page)
comments: Was 20 (16-24). 25+ years is claimed only for PTFE/PVDF-topcoated membranes.

description: kg of polyester fiber that goes to waste plastic incineration at end of life, per kg of product
source: EU 2022: separately collected textiles: 15% incinerated, 12% landfilled (EEA); plastic packaging 2022: 35.0% energy recovery vs ~24.3% other disposal (European Parliament); recycling assumed ~0 for coated membranes
comments: Incineration:landfill = 35/(35+24.3) = 59% (plastics) or 15/(15+12) = 56% (textiles). Was 0.7/0.3. NL has a landfill ban, so NL would be >90% incineration: max set to 0.95.

description: kg of polyester fiber that goes to waste plastic landfilling at end of life, per kg of product
source: EU 2022: separately collected textiles: 15% incinerated, 12% landfilled (EEA); plastic packaging 2022: 35.0% energy recovery vs ~24.3% other disposal (European Parliament); recycling assumed ~0 for coated membranes

description: Country whose electricity mix is displaced by energy recovered at end of life
comments: Common-sense estimate (Claude, for LCA-team review): Model choice, not a measurement: NL because the RAW project and its electricity/heat credit assumptions are Dutch and the ecoinvent NL grid is available. Only matters for the energy credit of incineration; change on study_setup if you model another country.
